windows.command: if (!(Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}\build-vscode')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory '${workspaceFolder}\build-vscode' | Out-Null }; Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}\build-vscode'; & 'D:\QtSDK\5.15.2\mingw81_64\bin\qmake.exe' ..\charging-platform.pro -spec win32-g++

$env:Path='D:\QtSDK\5.15.2\mingw81_64\bin;'+$env:Path; $exe=Get-ChildItem '${workspaceFolder}\build-vscode\admin_client' -Recurse -Filter ev_admin_client.exe | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$exe) { throw 'ev_admin_client.exe not found' }; & $exe.FullName

$env:Path='D:\QtSDK\5.15.2\mingw81_64\bin;'+$env:Path; $exe=Get-ChildItem '${workspaceFolder}\build-vscode\user_client' -Recurse -Filter ev_user_client.exe | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$exe) { throw 'ev_user_client.exe not found' }; & $exe.FullName

$env:Path='D:\QtSDK\5.15.2\mingw81_64\bin;'+$env:Path; $exe=Get-ChildItem '${workspaceFolder}\build-vscode\device_simulator' -Recurse -Filter ev_device_simulator.exe | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$exe) { throw 'ev_device_simulator.exe not found' }; & $exe.FullName --code DL-SW-001

$env:Path='D:\QtSDK\5.15.2\mingw81_64\bin;'+$env:Path; $exe=Get-ChildItem '${workspaceFolder}\build-vscode\mobile_client' -Recurse -Filter ev_mobile_client.exe | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$exe) { throw 'ev_mobile_client.exe not found' }; & $exe.FullName
